headline.text: L1 S1 pretzel batch held for *oil contamination* — 120 lb on boxes, source unknown, investigation open.

summary: One active hold: 120 lb pretzel slims at L1 S1 with oil residue on packaging, source unknown. One caramel hold (wrong corn syrup) was released after R&D approval. L1 S3 near-miss: 10-month-old chocolate barrel approved after QA inspection and mixing.

holds.title: Pretzel slims held for oil contamination on packaging
holds.summary: 120 lb of Item 10206 pretzel slims placed on hold after oil residue and odor found on boxes in first pallet row; source of oil spill unknown.
holds.status: On hold pending investigation of oil source and disposition decision.

holds.title: Caramel batch made with non-GMO corn syrup substitution — released
holds.summary: 850 lb caramel (one batch) made with regular corn syrup (10189) instead of specified non-GMO (10230); held pending R&D review, then approved for use and released.
holds.status: Resolved — released from hold at 11:05 after Ira Robison confirmed approval for use with rest of production run.

food_safety.title: 10-month-old chocolate barrel evaluated and approved
food_safety.summary: One barrel of chocolate with pistachios (shelf life ~9 months) had been stored since December 2025; QA found oil separation and oily taste, rejected initially, then approved after thorough mixing improved texture.
food_safety.status: Resolved — Victor Mejia approved for use at 00:53 after mixing; operators instructed to mix thoroughly before adding to buffer tank.

quality.title: ML4 depositor gasket improperly installed
quality.summary: Depositor 1 nozzle plate gasket found not properly seated during troubleshooting of hard chocolate clogs; plate removed, cleaned, ATP verified, and reinstalled with correct gasket.
quality.status: Resolved — nozzle plate cleaned, ATP passed at 15:00, new gasket installed, line restarted at 15:31.

quality.title: ML3 belt damage and replacement
quality.summary: Belt #7 on ML3 damaged, requiring line stop; maintenance replaced belt, QA performed ATP verification, line restarted.
quality.status: Resolved — belt replaced, ATP verified, line running again as of 12:17.

opportunities.text: Consider adding storage-date verification to ingredient staging checklist for extended-hold items — based on the 10-month-old chocolate barrel that required QA evaluation at S3 today.
Review labeling and storage separation for corn syrup variants (GMO vs. non-GMO) in S4 kitchen — today's batch was made with wrong specification, caught only after cooking.
Consider adding gasket-seating inspection to ML4 depositor nozzle-plate reinstallation procedure — today's improperly seated gasket contributed to hard-chocolate clogs and extended downtime.
